title: Entry field contract
description: What an entry-loop field must declare about itself, generalised from the W-2 Box 1 field built and evaluated in the entry-loop-synthetic milestone (Track 3). Source and destination make criterion 2.1 checkable against a declaration; purpose makes 2.2 checkable; format is the Track 2d accepted-format shape, generalised; correction names how an already-answered fact is located and changed. This schema is not wired into the kernel SchemaRegistry and validates no runtime act, fact, or finding -- it models the shape an entry surface's own field declaration takes, the same way citation.v1 models a citation without itself being a kernel citizen. Whether this should become a ratified ADR and a first-class citizen is an open recommendation, not decided here.

source.description: The document a person is holding and the exact box or line on it (criterion 2.1). 'label' is the box's own printed name, distinct from its identifier, so a field can name both 'Box 1' and 'Wages, tips, other compensation' without concatenating them into one string a renderer must parse back apart.

destination.description: The return line the value feeds.

accepted_format.description: The Track 2d w2-box1-format.js shape, unchanged in behaviour and generalised in name only. One declaration governs the hint a person reads, the validator that accepts or refuses, and the refusal message.

correction.description: How an already-answered fact is located and changed without restarting the session. 'kind' is an open enum of one member today; W-2 Box 1's own correction reuses the same field and input rather than opening a second view, which is the only shape this milestone observed and the reason the enum is not yet closed to it.
